content.text: recurrent VVC: first a longer induction, eg, fluconazole 100, 150 or 200 mg every third day for 3 doses (days 1, 4 and 7), then fluconazole 100, 150 or 200 mg weekly for 6 months = the maintenance regimen; uncomplicated VVC: fluconazole 150 mg PO single dose; severe VVC: 150 mg in two sequential doses (second dose 72 h after the first); pregnancy: ⍉ fluconazole (a single 150 mg dose might be linked to spontaneous abortion and congenital anomalies).

vaginal candidiasis dose 150 mg PO single dose. CI: hypersensitivity to fluconazole or excipients; QT-prolonging CYP3A4 substrates (eg, erythromycin, pimozide, quinidine). Caution in liver dysfun: rare serious hepatotoxicity, incl deaths (mainly in pts w serious underlying dz). Rare QT prolongation and torsades reported; hypokalemia and advanced HF ↑ the risk of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias; ⍉ combine w erythromycin (cardiotoxicity, sudden death). High-dose (400 to 800 mg/day) first-trimester exposure: case reports of distinct congenital anomalies. Single-dose tablet: more drug-related AEs than intravaginal agents (26% vs 16%).
